scope: Output-only parameterized adapter of the previously sealed analyze_training_action_distribution.mjs; old script unchanged
output: --output new JSON path inside outputs/ppo_height_and_p02_recovery_v1; existing files rejected
execution_status: Synthetic two-decision self-test passed; not run against real audits

contract_handling.source: Saved checkpoint manifest policy_contract, matched to completed receipt configuration
contract_handling.full_contract_validation: Exact supported HISTORY or tempered HISTORY contract; unknown/mixed versions rejected

analysis.audit_passes: One streaming decision-audit pass per explicitly supplied sealed run
analysis.memory: Online per-phase/per-channel population moments; no raw trajectory retention or quantile sort
analysis.phases: P01-P13 actual request phase; terminal end phase counted separately
derived: learned sigma = recorded effective sigma / exact contract temperature
z = (raw - conditional mean) / recorded effective sigma
analysis.derived_learned_sigma_limit: Not independent head readout; floating-point exp(log_sigma+log(tau)) rounding remains
analysis.all12: Enabled-mask proof and all-tick native audit verification, plus separate actual endpoint nonzero counts per channel
analysis.terminal: Actual recorded row.terminal only with no bootstrap; nonterminal budget tails not counted as episodes
analysis.teacher: Reject credited teacher flag; prefix runs require explicit false per row and sealed receipt exclusion proof

causal_limit: This adapter distinguishes sampling scale from learned scale; neither sigma statistics nor enabled masks establish physical success, torque saturation, beneficial learning, or the cause of P02 failure.
